data.title: 橘美花莉 · 放学天台的独占视线
data.description: 放学后的夕阳天台铁丝网旁，美花莉身着薰衣草色薄针织开衫与俏丽短裙，微卷的栗棕长发被黄昏暖风吹拂，两侧小巧的粉色蝴蝶结发带随风轻晃。她将一罐冰凉的红茶轻贴在奥村脸上，鼓起腮帮娇嗔抱怨他放学又打算直奔漫研社，夕阳余晖为她傲娇又深情的侧颜镀上一层浓郁的暖金光芒。
data.location: 学校教学楼天台铁丝网旁
data.action: 微风中将冰红茶轻贴奥村脸颊，鼓起香腮娇嗔傲娇，粉眸在夕阳下眼波流转
data.promptProse: On the school rooftop beside the chainlink fence at golden hour, Mikari Tachibana playfully presses a chilled canned tea against the viewer's cheek with an affectionate pout. Her wavy chestnut brown hair flows across her shoulders in playful two-side-up bunches tied with pink ribbons, fluttering gently in the evening breeze. Sunset light bathes her lavender cardigan, trendy skirt and flushed cheeks in warm amber hues, capturing a tender, nostalgic moment between long-time childhood sweethearts. Clear medium shot framed against the glowing sky.
